CrossMux 1.5.8 unifies the X3/X4 firmware across all supported languages, adds automatic Chinese UI font installation and system-settings reset, and improves WeRead touch behavior and reader reliability.

## Firmware and setup

- Ship one multilingual X3/X4 image. The first-start language choice selects the regional content profile without changing the firmware binary.
- Automatically install the Simplified Chinese UI font when it is needed and available from the configured content region.
- Add a system-settings reset that preserves books and reading data.

## Reading and reliability

- Improve WeRead touch gestures, progress handling, annotation filtering, and cache behavior.
- Improve wake refreshes, sleep-screen handling, reader performance, and recovery under constrained memory.
- Update FreeInk SDK device support while retaining the X3/X4 board and OTA safety checks.

## Release scope

- Stable 1.5.8 supports Xteink X3 and X4 with one shared ESP32-C3 image.
- Sticky, X4 Pro, Paper Mono, EEGO A4, Murphy M4, and Waveshare ePaper 3.97 remain available through Nightly only.
- Existing books, reading progress, settings, and downloaded content are preserved during a normal OTA update.

## Firmware assets

- `firmware.bin` and `firmware-cn.bin` contain the same multilingual firmware for compatibility with existing clients.
- `bootloader.bin` and `partitions.bin` remain available for guided web/USB recovery flows.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/0x1abin/crossmux/compare/1.5.7...1.5.8
